description: Yu Ding at Texas A&M University publishes ten-minute wind-turbine and meteorological observations accompanying Data Science for Wind Energy. The September 2021 ZIP describes six turbines paired with three meteorological masts. Paired turbine periods cover July 2010–July 2011, April 2010–April 2011 and calendar year 2009. Variables include wind speed and direction, air density, turbulence, vertical shear and, offshore, humidity and above-hub shear, alongside turbine response. Downloads are free under CC BY 4.0. These measurements can calibrate power-response models and compare inland and offshore simulation assumptions. The repository does not identify farm locations or internal file formats, and environmental-variable availability differs between sites. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the collection. A separately deposited second dataset covers longer operating histories. Measurement uncertainty, missing-data treatment and turbine representativeness were not independently checked.
